pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Where does the River Ganga begin? (1 mark)
   A. In the Himalaya mountains
   B. In the Rift Valley
   C. At the Indian Ocean coast
   D. In Lake Victoria

2. Which is a role of trees and plants? (1 mark)
   A. They make the sun set
   B. They give oxygen and shade
   C. They stop rain forever
   D. They dry up rivers

3. How can water be used in worship? (1 mark)
   A. To make bells ring
   B. To build the temple roof
   C. To wash the hands and feet before prayer
   D. To burn incense

4. Which activity shows how to care for the environment? (1 mark)
   A. Planting a tree in the school compound
   B. Burning waste in the field
   C. Throwing rubbish out of a matatu
   D. Cutting trees for fun

5. Who was Devadatta in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A Sikh Guru
   B. Siddhartha's father
   C. A Jain monk
   D. Siddhartha's cousin

6. Where was Prince Siddhartha born? (1 mark)
   A. Lahore
   B. Amritsar
   C. Varanasi
   D. Lumbini

7. What is the Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. A book of maps
   B. A list of temples
   C. A long story of a king
   D. A book of wise sayings and verses

8. What does Dainik mean? (1 mark)
   A. Weekly
   B. Daily
   C. Monthly
   D. Yearly

9. What is the main idea of the Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   B. To ask for food
   C. To ask for money
   D. To ask for rain

10. What is a good posture for prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Lie down and talk
   B. Eat snacks
   C. Jump around
   D. Sit calmly with hands folded

11. What does the Gayatri Mantra compare wisdom to? (1 mark)
   A. Light
   B. A drum
   C. A river
   D. A mountain

12. On which festival do many students pray to Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Paryushan
   B. Vasant Panchami
   C. Madaraka Day
   D. Maha Shivratri

13. What does the veena stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Music and the arts
   B. Wealth
   C. Rain
   D. War

14. Which is a benefit of praying every day? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us taller
   B. It teaches discipline
   C. It stops all rain
   D. It makes homework disappear

15. What did King Harishchandra give up rather than break his promise? (1 mark)
   A. His kingdom
   B. His lamp
   C. His horse
   D. His shoes

16. What should passengers do before boarding a vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Jump onto it
   B. Run alongside it
   C. Wait for the vehicle to stop
   D. Push others

17. When should you practise yoga? (1 mark)
   A. While eating
   B. Right after a big meal
   C. When your stomach is not full
   D. While running

18. What should you practise yoga on? (1 mark)
   A. A wet floor
   B. A mat
   C. A road
   D. A tree

19. Which of these is a good way to pray? (1 mark)
   A. Say thank you and ask for wisdom and kindness
   B. Sit and laugh
   C. Ask only for gifts
   D. Shout

20. Every living being has what, according to Hindu belief? (1 mark)
   A. An atma, a small part of the divine
   B. A temple
   C. A festival
   D. A scripture

21. What does Daya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness or compassion
   B. Speed
   C. Wealth
   D. Anger

22. According to the teaching, what happens to good actions? (1 mark)
   A. They bring bad luck
   B. They are forgotten
   C. They have no results
   D. They bring good results

23. How should we behave when the National Anthem is sung? (1 mark)
   A. Stand straight and be quiet
   B. Run about
   C. Play
   D. Talk

24. What is a jagaran or vigil? (1 mark)
   A. Eating a big meal
   B. A meal
   C. A race
   D. Staying awake at night to pray and sing

25. What is done to the Shiva Linga on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. It is covered
   B. It is painted red
   C. It is thrown in a river
   D. It is bathed with water and milk

26. Who became the first Prime Minister of Kenya at that time? (1 mark)
   A. Mwai Kibaki
   B. Jomo Kenyatta
   C. Daniel arap Moi
   D. Tom Mboya

27. Which leaves are offered to Shiva on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Banana leaves
   B. Bel (bilva) leaves
   C. Tulsi leaves only
   D. Tea leaves

28. Which day is linked with Mercury? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Wednesday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Sunday

29. Which is the first month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Kartika
   B. Magha
   C. Phalguna
   D. Chaitra

30. Which is the last month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Magha
   B. Chaitra
   C. Ashadha
   D. Phalguna

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe three rites and rituals in a Mandir. (3 marks)

32. What is integrity? (2 marks)

33. Give three activities to learn about temples. (3 marks)

34. Explain what Hindus mean by an Avtar. (2 marks)

35. Explain the meaning of Kapaal Bhaati. (3 marks)

36. List four facts about the planets linked with the days. (4 marks)

37. Give two signs of integrity. (2 marks)

38. Describe how to set up a lost and found corner in a classroom. (4 marks)

39. Write three main teachings of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. (3 marks)

40. Describe the early life of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (4 marks)

41. Discuss how people of different faiths show respect for water and trees. (5 marks)

42. Why should children do Bhastrika and Kapaal Bhaati gently? (2 marks)

43. Write a short paragraph on why honesty is the best policy. (5 marks)

44. Match the days to the planets: Budhvaar, Guruvaar, Shukravaar. (3 marks)

45. State three rules of good behaviour when visiting a Mandir. (3 marks)

46. What is an asana? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — In the Himalaya mountains
   The Ganga starts high in the Himalaya and flows across northern India.

2. B — They give oxygen and shade
   Plants clean the air and give shade.

3. C — To wash the hands and feet before prayer
   Washing before prayer is a way of showing cleanliness and respect.

4. A — Planting a tree in the school compound
   Planting trees helps the environment.

5. D — Siddhartha's cousin
   Devadatta was a cousin.

6. D — Lumbini
   Lumbini is now in Nepal.

7. D — A book of wise sayings and verses
   It teaches how to live wisely.

8. B — Daily
   Dainik means daily.

9. A — To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   It asks for a clear mind.

10. D — Sit calmly with hands folded
   Calm sitting is respectful.

11. A — Light
   Wisdom is like light that clears away darkness.

12. B — Vasant Panchami
   Vasant Panchami honours Saraswati.

13. A — Music and the arts
   It is a musical instrument.

14. B — It teaches discipline
   Doing it regularly teaches discipline.

15. A — His kingdom
   He gave up his whole kingdom.

16. C — Wait for the vehicle to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

17. C — When your stomach is not full
   Do it with an empty stomach.

18. B — A mat
   A clean mat is best.

19. A — Say thank you and ask for wisdom and kindness
   Ask for wisdom, not only gifts.

20. A — An atma, a small part of the divine
   This is why Hindus respect all life.

21. A — Kindness or compassion
   Daya is compassion.

22. D — They bring good results
   Good actions bring good results.

23. A — Stand straight and be quiet
   We show respect.

24. D — Staying awake at night to pray and sing
   Devotees stay awake.

25. D — It is bathed with water and milk
   This is called abhishek.

26. B — Jomo Kenyatta
   Jomo Kenyatta was the first Prime Minister.

27. B — Bel (bilva) leaves
   Bel leaves are offered.

28. B — Wednesday
   Budhvaar.

29. D — Chaitra
   Chaitra comes first and Phalguna last.

30. D — Phalguna
   Phalguna is twelfth.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Darshan, aarti, prasad, bhajans, ringing the bell (any three, with a short description).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Being honest and doing what is right even when nobody is watching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honesty and 1 mark for doing right when unseen.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make a collage of temple pictures, map Mandirs on a sketch map or digital map, draw and colour a Mandir, visit one with permission (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: A form in which God is believed to come to earth to protect goodness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God coming to earth and 1 mark for protecting goodness.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kapaal means forehead and bhaati means shining, so it means shining forehead. The breath goes out in short pushes and breathing in happens by itself.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for meaning, quick breath out and automatic breath in.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mercury is closest to the Sun; Mars is the red planet; Jupiter is the largest; Saturn has rings (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Telling the truth, keeping promises, returning what is not yours, not cheating (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Place a box or table in a safe place, write each item in a book with the date and finder's name, let owners claim their things, and thank those who return items.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: There is one God, all human beings are equal, earn honestly and share with others, and serve without expecting a reward (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each teaching.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: He was born in Lahore with the childhood name Jetha, lost his parents young, helped his family by selling boiled grain, and later served Guru Amar Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hindus honour the Ganga and Tulsi; Sikhs remember the Beas and the Ber tree; Jains honour the Rijubalika and the Sal tree; Buddhists honour the Bodhi tree. All value water and trees and take care of them.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each faith correctly described, up to 4 marks, and 1 mark for the idea that all faiths show respect.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are active breathing exercises, so children need a teacher and must stop when tired.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: An honest person is trusted, feels calm, makes friends, keeps a good name and helps the community. A liar loses trust. Examples such as returning lost money or not cheating support the paragraph.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the topic, 2 marks for reasons, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for a clear conclusion.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mercury, Jupiter, Venus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, switch off phones, do not touch the murti, ask before taking photographs (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: A body posture.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for posture or seat.
